title: Acolyte
html:
Acolyte is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around religion. Shadowheart and the hireling Zenith Feur'sel have this background.

“
You have spent your life in service to a temple, learning sacred rites and providing sacrifices to the god or gods you worship. Serving the gods and discovering their sacred works will guide you to greatness.
„

Background features

  • Insight Proficiency: Gain proficiency with Wisdom (Insight) ability checks.
  • Religion Proficiency: Gain proficiency with Intelligence (Religion) ability checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
General
Anywhere 20 Fate Must Wait Resurrect anyone in your party.
  • Granted for the first resurrection of a party member in a playthrough, regardless of the means (with a spell, a scroll, or with the help of Withers).
  • If the Acolyte character cannot witness the resurrection (they are not in the active party, or they are the one who are resurrected), and they are the only one companion with this Background, the inspiration is not granted and cannot be obtained later.
Act 1
Dank Crypt 20 Divinity Undone Unlock and read the Book of Dead Gods.
  • Shared with ⁠Secrets of the Sundering inspiration.
Emerald Grove 25 Silvanus' Solitude Witness the ritual that seals off the grove from the world.
25 Treefather's Sorrow Unleash Silvanus' curse upon the grove.
  • Kill the druids and steal the Idol of Silvanus.
Grymforge 50 Acolytes of the Demonweb Pits Persuade the spiders in Grymforge to remain faithful to Lolth.
  • The inspiration can only be obtained with Speak with Animals active.
  • Despite the description, various ability checks can be used to convince the spiders.
Owlbear Nest 25 Her Gift of Silver Recover Selûne's lost treasure through prayer.
  • Read the prayer note while next to the locked chest.
  • Shadowheart cannot open the chest, but still gains the inspiration if she is present.
Shattered Sanctum 25 A Kiss Without Mercy Endure the ritual of Loviatar until Abdirak is pleased.
  • A character must succeed three ability checks on Performance or Intimidation (can be mixed), OR fail three Constitution checks.
  • Shedding the armour applies the  Ardent Apostle condition, helping to endure or imitate pain. Eating any spoiled/rotten food before the ritual applies the  Poisoned condition, which may help to fail Constitution checks.
  • Shared with ⁠The Art of Agony inspiration.
25 Saving the Heretic Learn about Maglubiyet and safely free his priest.
  • A party member must first talk to Brakkal, then get him out of trapped and locked cage. If freeing him first, the inspiration is not gained.
  • This can also be obtained by killing everyone in the temple, then freeing him, allowing him to escape unharmed; the spiders must be killed or still contained before freeing him, otherwise they will kill him.
Underdark 30 Last Rites of the Dark Dancer Complete Eilistraee's ritual of sorrow and obtain her blessed blade.
  • A character must succeed a Religion check to take the blade, or a Strength check to bypass the ritual.
30 Shatter the Moon Destroy Selûne's protection over the Underdark fort.
  • Destroy the Moonstone above the statue in the Selûnite Outpost.
30 Tipping the Scales Earn the worship of the Kuo-toa.
  • Also granted by convincing BOOOAL to let you kill in his name.
Waukeen's Rest 30 A Unified Spirit Pray with the Flaming Fists at Waukeen's Rest.
  • The option to do this is only available to Clerics of good-aligned deities and Paladins (except Oathbreakers).
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Cerimonia Alārum Release the Nightsong.
  • Shared with ⁠Damsel No More, ⁠Good Deed of the Day, and ⁠Soldier of Faith inspirations.
  • Additionally, shared with ⁠Fickle Allegiances and ⁠Rebellious Phase, if the party helped Balthazar to reach Shadowfell and betrayed him there.
75 Cerimonia Compedum Execute the ritual to bring Nightsong to Ketheric.
  • Ally with Balthazar and allow him to take Nightsong.
  • Shared with ⁠Soldier of Fortune inspiration.
75 In Her Footsteps Solve each of Shar's trials in the Gauntlet of Shar.
  • Shared with ⁠Recognised by Shadows inspiration and inspirations earned throughout the Self-Same Trial.
75 Sole Survivor Discover the truth behind the numerous rats in the Gauntlet of Shar.
  • Shared with ⁠Rat King inspiration.
75 Those for Whom the Bell Tolled Kill all of Balthazar's undead.
Last Light Inn 50 Moonweaver's Prayer Witness Isobel's ritual to keep up the protection of Last Light.
  • Acquired only if the Acolyte character is present when talking to Isobel for the first time.
50 Tragic Love Witness Yonas' funeral.
  • Talk to Meygan while she's mourning Yonas at the fane at X: -61 Y: 112.
  • Obtainable only before Marcus' attempt to kidnap Isobel.
  • Shared with ⁠Memento Mori inspiration.
Mind Flayer Colony 60 A Piece of Three Piece together Ketheric's allegiances.
Reithwin Town 60 Blessed's Final Rest Find the aasimar's journal.
  • On the desk at X: 47 Y: -1010 in the House of Healing Morgue.
  • Shared with ⁠Snuffed Spark inspiration.
60 Did My Homework Recite Shar's dogma to the surgeon.
  • The interacting character must choose the line with  DC 14 Religion Check and pass it. It is not connected to Malus's notes in his office.
  • This check is not available to Shadowheart, but she still can obtain the inspiration as a companion.
60 Honing the Darkness Pass all of Shar's tests in the middle of the cursed town.
  • Pass  DC 14 Saving Throw on Charisma, Intelligence and Wisdom (not necessary done by the same party member).
Ruined Battlefield 50 Let Sleeping Dogs Lie Prevent He Who Was from completing his task.
  • Either grant Madeline forgiveness or make the Shadar-Kai stab himself multiple times.
  • Granted as well if the party defeats He Who Was after taking up quest, without giving him Madeline's ledger.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠No Rest for the Wicked inspiration.
50 No Rest for the Wicked Assist He Who Was in his task.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Let Sleeping Dogs Lie inspiration.
Act 3
Lower City 170 Child Protection Agents Find and rescue Lora's daughter, Vanra.
  • Shared with ⁠Finding Vanra inspiration.
170 Offerings to the Waves Make an offering for the dead waveservant.
  • There are two options to gain this inspiration:
    • Place anything into the Offerings Chest in the Water Queen's House.
    • Speaking to Allandra Grey for the first time, choose the option about any offering, including Monk and Barbarian specific lines.
  • Shared with ⁠Sea Memorial inspiration, if obtained from Allandra Grey.
170 Ordinary Practises in Extraordinary Times Offer appropriate offerings to a deity in the Stormshore Tabernacle.
  • The offering is the same amount as needed to get a merchant to 100 Attitude as seen here.
220 Rites of Loss Complete the Mapping of the Heart.
220 True Exorcism Burn Kerri's portrait with the Torch of Revocation and banish Kerri from the Material Plane.
  • Obtainable only if Oskar Fevras was saved from the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.
  • Shared with ⁠Flames of Passion and ⁠Using the Proper Means inspirations.
170 What Remains of the Dead Guide Nina to acceptance or prowess.
  • She can be found in the Graveyard (Lower City). Either helping her resurrect her brother or convincing her not to will award the inspiration.
Murder Tribunal 220 Liturgy of Blood Embrace Bhaal and complete the Murder Tribunal.
  • Despite the description, the inspiration is earned if any party member becomes an Unholy Assassin, not only the Dark Urge.
  • Shared with ⁠Death of Innocence and ⁠Titles for the Collection inspirations.
220 Revulsion of Blood Free Valeria during the Murder Tribunal.
  • Shared with ⁠A Step Too Far and ⁠End of the Tribunal inspirations.
Rivington 135 A Scorned Closed Heart Side with the open-minded priest.
  • In the dialogue with the priests, choose "Sounds like your god would be proud of Father Logan".
135 A Test of Faithfulness Ask the Master of Love to test your bond.
  • Shared with ⁠Knowledge of the Heart, if the player character scores the best possible result with their partner.
135 A Wounded Open Heart Side with the close-minded priest.
  • In the dialogue with the priests, choose "If Father Logan had been pickier, he might still been alive".
135 Food for the Soul Donate a Long Rest's worth of food to the donation chest.[1]
  • Shared with ⁠Alms for the Unfortunate, ⁠Gifts of the Wilds, ⁠Sharing the Spoils, and ⁠Spare What You Can inspirations.
135 Needs of the Many Persuade the merchant to let the refugee squatters stay in his home.
  • Shared with ⁠Finders Keepers and ⁠Securing Hospitality inspirations.
  • Also shared with ⁠Exerting Judgement inspiration, if the party sided with Ben Golewits.
135 The Dismemberment of Dribbles Find all the pieces of Dribbles' body and return them to Lucretious.
  • Shared with ⁠Macabre Enigma, ⁠Macabre Hunt, and ⁠Trail of Blood inspirations.
Undercity 220 Forgotten, Bloodied, Halls Discover the Temple of Bhaal.
  • Granted upon opening the doors to the temple itself in the Undercity Ruins
  • Shared with ⁠Homecoming and ⁠The Face of Evil inspirations.
170 Grinning with Bhaal Agree to an alliance with Orin.
  • Granted if the party accept Orin's proposition after she kidnaps a companion. For a Dark Urge, accepting a duel challenge also grants the inspiration.
Wyrm's Crossing 135 Carnal Rituals of Sharess Take part in the... erm... negotiable affection provided in Sharess' Caress.
  • Unlike other similar inspirations, this one concerns only the deal with the drow twins.
  • The Acolyte character must be the player character's romantic partner, which in general case narrows the variations to Shadowheart only.
  • Shared with ⁠Alternative Vocations and ⁠Giving a Private Performance inspirations.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Shaking Bane's Hand Agree to an alliance with Gortash.

Cut Background Goals

  • Justice Sees All: Discover why Anders betrayed Tyr.
    • In Early Acess, Anders was a fallen paladin of Tyr. However, in the release version his backstory was changed to simply be a servant of Zariel pretending to be a paladin; therefore, the dialogue that would trigger this inspiration was removed.

Notes and References

  1. ↑ Despite the formulation, donating at least 40 Camp Supplies is enough to earn inspiration on Tactician difficulty level (presumably, Honour too)
